messages:
Aisha (CS): FYI — I'm drafting a short customer-facing runbook for trial->prod ramps. Focus: graduated sampling, safe-priming (small warm pools), and a renewal-signal primitive we’re calling 'grace tokens'. Want quick feedback before we publish to the onboarding kit.

Tom (CS): Love the name 'grace tokens'. Quick Q: how heavy do we want the prefill to be for trials vs paid?

Aisha (CS): Good call. Proposal: trials get light priming (2–5 warm requests over 5–10m), paid gets medium (10–50 warm requests over 30–60m) depending on expected qps. Keep default TTL short (5m) then extend post-go-live.

Ravi (SRE): From infra side — prefer adaptive batches during warm window. Start with a 20ms batching window, then tighten to 5–10ms after steady state. Watch tail latency at p99 and kv-cache hit rate.

Tom (CS): Example checklist I'm imagining: 
- Confirm tenant capacity and quota
- Apply safe-priming (2x sample prompts)
- Enable prefix caching for top 5 intents
- Add grace-token flag to billing metadata

Aisha (CS): Adding a tiny sample prompt set in the doc — 6 prompts across core intents, edge intents, and a failover intent. We use these for quality regression checks and live telemetry.

Lena (PM): Where do we capture customer feedback during ramp? Need a short script for AMs and a capture field in the console.

Aisha (CS): Suggested capture flow: 1) quick 3-question survey after first 24h of go-live (CSAT / major blocker / open text), 2) automated sample-rate quality check every 6h, 3) immediate escalation if regression > 3% degraded responses on critical prompts.

Ravi (SRE): Snippet for batching config to put in runbook: 
```
batching: 
  warm_window_ms: 20  # during priming
  steady_window_ms: 8  # normal ops
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
```

Tom (CS): For grace tokens: we add a 'grace_token' boolean to tenant metadata and a ttl window attached to it. When active, renewal outreach gets extended priority and a small token of compute reserved for demos.

Aisha (CS): I'll draft the actual JSON snippets and the AM script. Want to include a short 'what to say' for risky-renewal customers. Example: "We observed X usage patterns during your trial; we recommend Y to stabilize costs — want a quick walk-through?"

Lena (PM): Perfect. Also add a line about rollback: automatic fallback to smaller model family and a notify-to-AM hook if latency spikes > 2x baseline.

Ravi (SRE): Add metrics to watch in the runbook: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, kv-cache hit%, priming success rate, and renewal-grace token usage. Alert thresholds suggested in the doc.

onboard-bot: New doc created: "trial-to-prod-grace-token-priming-playbook" (internal link) — please review in #customer-success/docs.

Tom (CS): quick thumbs — I'll test the sample prompts on a sandbox tenant later today and report back. :+1:

Aisha (CS): Awesome. If no major changes I’ll publish a 1-page handout and a 2-step AM script by EOD tomorrow. Thanks for the quick input!
